anchor.quote: the Ward-Seal fractures into unstable resonance before the iron doors unlatch
anchor.prefix: fails a Breach check on a 6 or lower,
anchor.suffix: , adding +2 segments to the room clock

messages.author: Mira (Systems Review)
messages.body: If the +2 resonance surge fills segment 4/4 on the room clock, does the room hazard trigger before or after the jammed-bolt status is applied?

messages.author: Rules Bot
messages.body: Good catch: the bolt jams atomically on step 4, then clock overflow resolves immediately afterward so the party cannot slip through an open doorway during discharge.

anchor.quote: each breach attempt caps committed Lantern Oil at two charges per action

messages.author: Devon (Balance)
messages.body: Previously uncapped Lantern Oil let high-supply teams guarantee 10+ on Tier III vaults. Confirming the two-charge ceiling matches the Outcome Playground slider.

messages.author: Devon (Balance)
messages.body: Verified against the playground slider max=2. Marking resolved.

history.note: Slider range and prose aligned at 2 charges.
